surface: Full @measured/puck@0.20.2 core port — Puck editor, Render, DropZone, hooks, and config types.
divergences: Native onChange on controlled text inputs (ExternalInput search field) — upstream React synthetic onChange; Octane uses onInput for per-edit.
use-debounce replaced with @octanejs/tanstack-pacer useDebouncer in DragDropContext.
notes: Private workspace scaffold until the published source passes strict external-consumer validation.
The whole src tree typechecks with tsrx-tsc in the root typecheck lane (packages/puck/tsconfig.json).
Source ported from puckeditor/puck packages/core via scripts/port-upstream.mjs.
The port script omits seven upstream lib files that are absent from Puck's public core surface and have no consumers in the port.
Render and full Puck editor shell mount pass conformance tests (2026-08-07); the editor renders stored content, its iframe preview, and DropZone refs (2026-09-30).

@dnd-kit/react and lucide-react rewired to @octanejs/dnd-kit and @octanejs/lucide; @dnd-kit/* upgraded to catalog 0.5.0. Puck's pointer activation constraints, drag event handler types, and sortable clone feedback use the 0.5 APIs.
Plain .ts modules that call hooks carry a leading /** @jsxImportSource octane */ pragma so the compiler slots hooks they import through react-shim; the port script adds it.
